title: Army adapting NHI-derived electro-optic cloaking to combat vehicles

tellings.quote: There have been instances in the early 2000s in which specifically the army uh was interested in adapting electrooptic cloaking to next generation combat vehicle.

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says on Jesse Michels's podcast that in the early 2000s the US Army wanted to fit electro-optic cloaking, a technology that hides objects from sight using light and electronics, onto its next generation of combat vehicles. In this story the technology is said to come from non-human intelligence, meaning beings that are not human. If true, it would mean such technology was being turned into military hardware.
